{{Quote|Captain Katarn, we lost power to this section. We need you to get over to the generator and switch us over to auxiliary power.|The officer explains the predicament|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as an '''officer''' in the [[New Republic Army]] and was stationed on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Altyr V base|base]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]].<ref name="MOTS" /> During [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] worked alongside a [[Color/Legends|red-and-white]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in the communications room when two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial artificial asteroids|weapons]] disguised as [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] [[Battle of Altyr V|bombarded]] their shields before launching siege parties. During the assault, Imperial forces damaged the power connection to the officer's station. The officer was left in the darkness with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] until [[field stormtrooper]]s burst through holes the walls.<ref name="MOTS" />

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]] arrived to the area while searching for the base's communications center. The officer tasked Katarn with locating and reactivating the auxiliary generator deep within the base's bunkers. Katarn [[Death/Legends|cut]] through the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] guarding the area, and he returned with power restored. A door in the officer's control room, that had been previously locked due to the power outage, was unlocked, and the comms room was greeted by a stormtrooper with a [[rail detonator]]. Katarn left the officer and droid at their stations to continue the fight while they jammed Imperial sensors and communications.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. All New Republic officers were voiced by either [[Steve Blum]] or [[Roger Jackson]].<ref name="MOTS" />
